question: What textual attribution and chapter title conclude this section of the Merutantra?
premises: The text is the Merutantra approved by Shri Mahamaya and Mahakala.
It is attributed as composed by Shiva.
The section is named the twenty-eighth chapter on the mantra dear to Vishnu.
inference: This concludes the twenty-eighth chapter on the mantra dear to Vishnu in the Shiva-composed Merutantra.
plain_english: Thus, in the Merutantra approved by Shri Mahamaya and Mahakala and composed by Shiva, ends the twenty-eighth chapter named the account of the mantra dear to Vishnu.
